channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Animalica - Compatibility Pack 3 (Dinosaurs)
item.description: Adds clothing-capable playable dinosaurs and marine reptiles from Legacy of the Phanerozoic modules

item.title: Custom Music Radio
item.description: A physical radio that streams server-owned Ogg Vorbis music to clients

item.title: Feral Kinship: Companions
item.description: Gives tamed animals personalities, backpacks, duties, talents, breeding, and expeditions.

item.title: Rust Arrival
item.description: Rust creatures now spawn with a special effect. Purely cosmetic, configurable.

item.title: Petroleum Age: Iron & Refining Patch
item.description: Petroleum Age: Iron & Refining Patch adds iron-friendly recipes, crude oil → bitumen → coke cooking,

item.title: Remember It
item.description: Remembers where you have been and draws it onto your Frontier's Map, a little more each visit.

item.title: Sharpening & Whetstones
item.description: Sharpen axes, scythes, knives, spears and arrows; whetstones and a hand-sharpening minigame.

item.title: Mining Expanded
item.description: Mine air and ventilation, firedamp, dust, blasting, ore quality, cribs and miner's hard hats.

item.title: Geologic Coal Seams
item.description: Big stacked geologic coal seams in four ranks, with outcrops, loose coal and fireclay.

item.title: Mine Carts
item.description: Free-form mine rails at any angle, five carts, winches, switches, trains and a pump car.

item.title: Advanced Research
item.description: Learn recipes from lore books and research them at a desk, with Minesweeper and 15 vanilla books.

item.title: Cargo Clothing
item.description: Cargo pants, overalls, pockets, tool belts, sheaths and waxed clothes that keep the rain off.

item.title: Offline Bodies
item.description: Logged out players leave a sleeping body others can loot and drag. They wake in it when they return.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Bovinae
item.description: A collection of antelopes, bison, buffalo and cattle from the Holocene.

item.title: The Rookery
item.description: Real messenger birds that fly your letters across the world and can be shot down, plus wild birds

item.title: Sauna
item.description: Seal a room, light the iron stove, splash a watering can over the hot stones, and you have a sauna

item.title: Raptor race
item.description: This mod adds playable a race of humanoid raptors called Reliquiaeraptor.

item.title: Caeloria: Content
item.description: Content pack for Caeloria: Reborn. Doesn't include any code mods, those are different mods.

item.title: Teapot's Giant Redriver
item.description: The redhead chonkers are at your service on your adventures down south!

item.title: VSA - Replica
item.description: (Valkyrian Skies for VS basically) Build block-made moving ships and structures

item.title: aikostweaks
item.description: Personal mod for my friend server

item.title: Vara's Crabapples
item.description: Little crabapples populating the north. Less satiety but extremely cold-hardy!

item.title: Vara's Tree Line
item.description: Better tree line simulation! Trees are sparser past the arctic circle.

item.title: Crown & Coalition Chapter 2
item.description: Chapter 2 additions for C&C.

item.title: Crown & Coalition Server Tweaks
item.description: For details on content, please contact me directly via Discord.

item.title: Rough Seas
item.description: The sea gets weather: storms, surf, currents. And six new vessels that wear, swamp and break.

item.title: The Mad Crow Attacks
item.description: The Mad Crow Attacks at night. Run, hide, fight, mount. Choose what you can do to escape/fight back.

item.title: Boric Alchemy
item.description: Welcome to the alchemists' guild <3

item.title: Nature's Call REMADE
item.description: A rewrite of the legendary mod Nature's Call. No longer crashes the game when you pee on a friend

item.title: Terra Incognita: True Value
item.description: Granular metallurgy: salvage items into bits, inline gear & cookware, and manage metal toxicity.
